note: RBC Royal Bank only: CIBC Caribbean's card schedules for Barbados refused the request (403) on the host that serves them, and Republic Bank's weren't reached in this pass. RBC Royal Bank's page of personal credit cards for Barbados (read 30 October 2026), read in full: every card it offers individuals (5; the business cards, and the RBC Rewards Visa Platinum Black, offered only to Private Banking clients, a condition the game doesn't check, aren't written), each with its annual fee for the first card, in US dollars where the card is, its purchase rate a year and its cash advance rate a year. The page states no minimum payment, grace period, late fee or foreign transaction fee. Wave 4 (30 October 2026) added Scotiabank Barbados, one of the island's largest banks, whose credit card rates and fees schedule (last updated November 2025) was read in full: its personal Mastercards (Scotiabank, Gold, AAdvantage and AERO Platinum), in Barbados dollars, each with its annual purchase rate, a range set on approval, written at its top with its bottom as the range's lowest, its cash advance rate, its annual membership fee, a $49 late payment fee and $49 over-limit charge, a cash advance fee of 2.99% (3.00% on the AERO Platinum), at least $10, $30 for a returned cheque, a minimum payment of 3%, at least $50, an interest-free period of at least 21 days on purchases paid in full (written as 21), and the rate after a missed minimum payment, up to 29.49%, written as the penalty rate (not on the AERO Platinum, whose own top rate, 29.99%, is above it). The business cards, the ScotiaLine and the Premium Banking table (a banking segment the game doesn't check) aren't written, nor the $20 credit bureau report fee. It states no foreign currency charge. Tried and not used: Republic Bank Barbados's site didn't answer and First Citizens' refused the request (403). Wave 4 (30 October 2026) also added CIBC Caribbean, one of the region's largest banks, whose Barbados schedule of charges for cards (effective may 2022, last updated july 2026) its site now serves (an earlier pass found it refused or not linked): read in full, its personal credit cards (12), each with its annual fee for the primary card (none where the schedule gives 0.00 or Free; waived for the first year where the schedule says so), its yearly purchase rate, its cash advance rate and fee, its late payment, over-limit and returned cheque fees, the minimum payment where the schedule gives one, and its late payment rate as the penalty rate, as the earlier CIBC files do. Its business, corporate, commercial and Bizline cards aren't written, nor the replacement, statement, rush card, emergency payment and auto-payment charges, which a holder meets only by asking or by an auto-payment; the UWI cards are for the University of the West Indies' students, faculty and alumni, a condition the game doesn't check. It states no grace period or foreign transaction fee. No minimum payment is published for CIBC Caribbean's cards other than its JetBlue cards, and RBC's cards; tried (wave 5, 30 October 2026): every document this file cites, downloaded again on 30 October 2026 and searched for a minimum payment, states none for them; CIBC Caribbean's schedule of charges for the country gives a minimum only for its JetBlue cards (written where it has them) and 10% for business cards; its FirstCaribbean credit card cardholder agreement (7040CC-FC-24-02, read in full) says only 'the minimum payment required as stipulated in the monthly statement'; a search in English for CIBC Caribbean's minimum payment found only CIBC Canada's documents and a calculator site; RBC's Caribbean credit card pages for the country state no minimum payment; archive.org's availability API, asked for each of the 3 documents this file cites, names a snapshot for 1 of them, which can't be read, web.archive.org being refused from here.
